product_metadata.title: KAF Home Pantry Piedmont Terry Kitchen Towels | Set of 8, 16 x 26 inch, Absorbent Terry Cloth Dish Towels, Hand Towels, Tea Towels | Perfect for Kitchen Spills, Cooking, and Messes - Light Gray
features: SET OF 8: Keep your kitchen surfaces tidy and your messes at bay with this set of eight premium quality terry dish towels
PREMIUM QUALITY: Made from luxurious terrycloth cotton (exclusive of stripes for decoration). 98% Cotton, 2% Polyester (for decoration)
ABSORBENT: Each measuring 16 x 26, these terry kitchen towels are an ultra absorbent, environmentally friendly, and beautiful alternative to paper towels
FASHIONABLE: These towels have a classy woven stripe and matching back towels to add an element of fashion to any kitchen, while keeping spills and cooking messes under control.

EASYCARE: Machine wash cold with like colors, tumble dry low. As with any linens, some minimal shrinkage may occur. For darker colors, please wash with like colors. Please note that lack of adherence to instructions may lead to minimal color bleeding.
